description: This donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of journalistic stimuli, categorized by their proportion within a dataset. The chart contains eight distinct slices, each corresponding to a specific type of stimulus and labeled with its name and percentage share. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Press Release” at 21.9%. Following in size are “Interview” (10.2%, dark blue), “External News Article” (13.1%, dark green), “Organizational Report” (8.8%, purple), and “Event Posting” (8.8%, lighter purple), which are visually comparable in size. Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” (6.6%, light blue), “Social Media Post” (1.5%, light green), and “Intra-agency news article” (0.7%, a very thin orange slice). Each category is labeled externally with its name and percentage, and the chart includes a central title. The segments are arranged clockwise in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top right and proceeding around the circle. There is no legend, no percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
